correctness.evidence: Independent 13-point PG(2,3), 1716 seven-subset and 5616 PGL3(3) enumeration: four types 18–21 have subset orbits 936,78,234,468 and stabilizers 6,72,24,12; all 8389 labeled abstract families accounted for.

originality.evidence: Geelen–Whittle 2013 full paper p2 explicitly says all ternary matroids uniquely representable over GF(3); Whittle 1995 same. Thus multiplicity-one and maximizer are preexisting general theorem; Mayhew–Royle small matroid catalogue covers type count.

scientific_value.evidence: Claimed uniqueness boundary is absent for the entire ternary class; residual four-row matrix list is a limited catalogue extraction and no new structural conclusion is shown.

limitations: Finite matrix table may remain a convenient benchmark
Prior uniqueness theorem is field-specific to GF(3)
